name: fileName
label: File name
help: Name of the file, with its extension. For example, `report.docx`. A Pages document must keep its `.pages` extension: only the name tells it from a Numbers spreadsheet, which conv2pdf does not convert.

name: data
label: Data
help: Content of the document to convert: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, Apple Pages, RTF, TXT or CSV.
